title: Unlucky Thief's Gloves
summary: Gain +2 Sleight of Hand. Stealing repeatedly can set you on fire.

fields.Sleight of Hand: +2 to Sleight of Hand checks. Each stolen item adds Charcoal to your inventory. The next theft after 20 instead adds a Coal Bucket and applies Burning for 1 turn.
fields.Burning: Takes 1d4 Fire per turn. Wet prevents this trigger. Help, a healing potion, or becoming Wet can remove standard Burning.
fields.Acquisition: Possible consolation prize from Akabi’s wheel at the Circus of the Last Days.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
